note: assistant review vs ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md (wave-2 silver, qwen2.5:14b); no human annotation
label: PATHWAY
conventions: shared-head coordination = ONE span (delete-conjunct test); partly-marked coordination scored as narrow-span TP + full-string FN
trailing 'pathway/pathways' stays in span; trailing 'metabolites/rate/efficiency/flux/genes/disorders/activity/function/enzymes' excluded (FP, often with carve-out FN)
disease/gene-set phrase embedding a pathway -> span only the pathway part; disease-class terms (e.g. amino acid disorders) are FP with carve-out FN when a pathway is embedded
compound/umbrella metabolism terms (e.g. lipid metabolism, cholesterol metabolism) count as PATHWAY

rejects: enzyme/protein/PTM, signalling pathways, cell-death (apoptosis/ferroptosis), transport (ABC transporters, glucose uptake), homeostasis states, phenotype (insulin resistance), bare compounds, deficiency diseases, DNA repair/methylation, protein synthesis/translation, chemical-compound synthesis
